Daily Devotional

January 17

14 But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil. (Hebrews 5:14 KJV)

Those that are of full age is referring to mature Christians who have grown in their knowledge of the Word of God, and the strong meat is the knowledge that they have learned from the Word. All, who are born again Christians, should continue in the study of God’s Word (Romans 12:2). That will make them mature into disciples indeed, of the Lord (John 8:31). The purpose of Jesus coming and dying for us was to give us everlasting life (John 17:3), and that is to bring us into close relationship with God and Jesus, not to just live forever, but to truly know them. So many Christians just get born again and then don’t ever try to grow and mature as a Christian. That is not doing what Jesus told us to do, and leaves some doubt as to whether you can maintain your salvation unless you work it out as the scriptures say (Philippians 2:12). You must obey Jesus to insure your eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9).

Notice that you need to exercise your senses, so you can determine both good and evil. Your senses have to be exercised just like your muscles have to be used to get stronger and stay healthy. You exercise your senses, by using them, and growing in your knowledge of the Word, and as James said “faith without works is dead” (James 2:20). You must show your faith in Jesus by doing the things He commanded us to do (John 14:12), and thereby you exercise your senses to be able to determine both good and evil, or what is from God or the Devil. Stay in the Word and grow to maturity and experience all the benefits that being a Christian can bring you. Praise God for His Word.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
